text:
maria: Heads-up — our JS onboarding flow shows just "Request failed with status code 502" and no guidance. New users hit this and abandon signup. Anyone seen a fast win?

sam.k: Ugh. We should at least surface model id + request_id + whether it's retryable. Example: 'Transient gateway error (502) — retryable; try exponential backoff; trace: xyz'

leo: +1. Also the SDKs don't expose typed exceptions (RateLimitError, ServerError, AuthError). Folks end up parsing message strings which is brittle.

maria: Repro snippet from a user (pasted):
```json
{ "name": "Error", "message": "Request failed with status code 502", "stack": "...", "config": { "model": "redwood-1" } }
```

jordan: Proposal: normalize error shape across SDKs to include these fields: code (string), http_status (int), retryable (bool), hint (string), request_id (string), backend (string), raw (object). That lets apps branch on type/hint instead of parsing text.

sam.k: For mapping rules: 429 -> retryable=true + include `retry_after` if present; 5xx -> retryable=true except 501/505; 401/403 -> auth error with clear remediation; 400 with model schema mismatch -> validation error w/ field hints.

maria: Quick example of new shape I'd like in SDKs:
```json
{
  "code": "gateway_error",
  "http_status": 502,
  "retryable": true,
  "hint": "transient gateway failure; try exponential backoff",
  "request_id": "req_abc123",
  "backend": "inference/gateway-v2",
  "raw": { "message": "Upstream timeout" }
}
```

leo: Sounds good. Implementation notes: JS should expose both an Error subclass (e.g., GatewayError) with those fields and the raw response on `err.meta`. Py should raise typed exceptions that inherit from RedwoodError. We'll need a compatibility shim so existing `err.message` still works.

sam.k: Also add a tiny sample for recommended retry policy in onboarding docs. E.g.:
```js
// recommended backoff
const backoff = (n) => Math.min(1000 * 2**n, 20000);
// treat err.retryable === true as eligible for retry
```

devex-bot: Created issue <https://git.internal/redwood/devex/issues/3421|devex#3421> — title: "SDK: normalized error shape + retry hints for onboarding". Assigned to leo.

maria: Can you own the SDK changes + migration notes? @leo

leo: I'll take it. Plan: open PR with JS/TS + Python changes, add changelog/migration guide, and include unit tests and a tiny sample app update. ETA Tue next week.

sam.k: Please include a short note for Dedicated/Private customers about how request_id and backend map to router/instance for support.

maria: Approved for onboarding milestone. Thanks y'all :rocket:
